narrative_purpose: Lays out the escalating ladder of what tsaheylu carries as three rungs of increasing data volume: the everyday animal bond (a thin command-and-feel link), the ancestral archive (a great stored library read back), and the consciousness transfer (a whole self crossing the wire) — the spread between them is the chapter's whole tension.
subject: A vertical three-tier naturalist diagram on a dark page. Lowest tier: a Na'vi riding a banshee, a thin bright thread of light running between queue and mount. Middle tier: a Na'vi kneeling at a glowing willow-like Tree of Voices, a broader river of light flowing from the tree's tendrils carrying faint ghostly ancestral faces. Top tier: a figure at the Tree of Souls dissolving into a vast torrent of light pouring into the network — the volume of light growing dramatically from bottom to top.
scene: Three stacked Pandoran night vignettes sharing one dark background, linked by the growing volume of the light-stream between organism and network.
camera: A flat, plate-like vertical stack, each tier read like a panel, even eye-level framing.
light: Bioluminescent key from the connecting light-streams; each tier brighter and more voluminous than the one below.
palette: Void-indigo ground, Pandora cyan and teal in the streams, faint magenta in the ancestral faces and the dissolving self.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, observed-from-life confidence.
detail_level: Crisp on the three connection-streams and their growing volume; figures suggested rather than fully rendered.
composition: Three horizontal bands stacked vertically, the stream of light widening top-ward, dark margins for labels at each tier.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette; reuse the glowing-tendril/stream language from fig-01. The visual grammar is volume-of-light = amount-of-data. Keep dark bands for labels.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
